plan.title: Explore workspace structure and existing artifacts
plan.description: List all files/directories in data/, examine existing yaml configs, existing train/val splits, and any pre-trained models or labels. Check what has already been set up (data_sc.yaml, data_multiclass.yaml, labels directories, etc.). Read annotations.json to understand category distribution, image sizes, annotation density.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of workspace: existing splits, configs, label formats, pre-computed assets. Understanding of annotation stats (categories, images, boxes per image, class frequency distribution).

plan.title: Verify environment, GPU, packages, and existing artifacts
plan.description: Check installed packages (ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes), GPU availability and VRAM, existing YOLO weights, data yaml files, train/val split files, and labels directories. Install any missing packages. This combines original steps 2-4.
plan.success_criteria: Complete inventory of available tools, GPU specs, and pre-existing artifacts documented.

plan.title: Fix PyTorch 2.6 / ultralytics compatibility and verify YOLO training works
plan.hypothesis: Monkey-patching torch.load to use weights_only=False or upgrading ultralytics will fix the model loading issue, enabling YOLO training.
plan.description: Apply a monkey-patch to torch.load at the top of main.py to set weights_only=False by default. Verify that YOLO model loading and a short 1-epoch training run works. This unblocks all subsequent YOLO experiments.
plan.success_criteria: YOLO model loads successfully and completes at least 1 epoch of training without errors.

plan.title: Build evaluation function and prepare YOLO dataset YAML
plan.hypothesis: A correct evaluation function matching the competition metric (0.7*detection_mAP@0.5 + 0.3*classification_mAP@0.5) is critical for reliable experiment comparison.
plan.description: Write evaluation function in utils.py using pycocotools that: (1) loads val annotations, (2) accepts predictions in COCO format, (3) computes detection_mAP@0.5 (single class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (per category), (4) returns combined val_score. Also prepare the YOLO dataset YAML file with proper paths and class names. Test eval function with dummy predictions.
plan.success_criteria: Evaluation function runs without errors on dummy data and produces reasonable mAP values.

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8x multiclass (nc=356) at 1280px, 50 epochs
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8x at 1280px gives a strong multiclass baseline. Starting with 50 epochs to get quick feedback before committing to longer training.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=356 on training split at imgsz=1280 for 50 epochs. Use close_mosaic=10, batch=auto. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function. This gives both detection and classification in one model.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes and we get a val_score metric. Target: val_score > 0.1 as initial baseline.

plan.title: Train single-class detector: YOLOv8x nc=1 at 1280px, 50 epochs
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector should have higher detection recall since it doesn't need to distinguish 356 categories, and detection is weighted 70% in the score.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x with nc=1 (all annotations mapped to class 0) at imgsz=1280 for 50 epochs. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 only. Compare to multiclass model's detection performance.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP@0.5 is higher than the multiclass model's detection mAP.

plan.title: Properly prepare YOLO label files and train YOLOv8m nc=356 at 640px, 30 epochs
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m at 640px with proper YOLO-format label files will train successfully without OOM, giving us a working multiclass baseline.
plan.description: Convert COCO annotations to YOLO label .txt files (one per image with normalized xywh format). Create proper train/val directory structure with symlinked images and label files. Train YOLOv8m (not x) at 640px with batch=-1 for 30 epochs. This smaller config should fit in GPU memory.

plan.title: Fix batch size and category mapping, train YOLOv8m nc=356 at 640px, 30 epochs
plan.hypothesis: Setting batch=8 explicitly (instead of AutoBatch) and fixing category_id to 0-indexed YOLO format will allow YOLOv8m training to complete successfully.
plan.description: Fix two issues: (1) Set batch=8 explicitly instead of batch=-1 to avoid AutoBatch OOM. (2) Remap category_ids to 0-indexed contiguous range for YOLO (create a cat_id_to_yolo_idx mapping). Also clean up any stale yolo_dataset directory. Train YOLOv8m at 640px for 30 epochs.

plan.title: Fix numpy.trapz compatibility and train YOLOv8m nc=356 at 640px, 30 epochs
plan.hypothesis: Adding a monkey-patch for numpy.trapz (using numpy.trapezoid if available, or scipy.integrate.trapezoid) will fix the validation crash, allowing YOLOv8m training to complete successfully.
plan.description: Add numpy.trapz compatibility fix at the top of main.py (before ultralytics import): check if numpy.trapz exists, if not, alias it from numpy.trapezoid. Keep all other settings from exp-008: YOLOv8m, 640px, batch=8, 30 epochs, nc=356 with proper category mapping. This should finally produce a working multiclass baseline.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes all 30 epochs and produces val_score > 0.0

plan.title: Train YOLOv8s nc=1 single-class detector at 640px, 30 epochs
plan.hypothesis: A single-class detector will have higher detection recall since detection is 70% of the score, and can be combined with a separate classifier later.
plan.description: Train YOLOv8s with nc=1 (all categories mapped to class 0), batch=16, 640px, 30 epochs. Compare detection_mAP with the multiclass model from step 9.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes and detection_mAP exceeds the multiclass model's detection_mAP

plan.title: Scale up best model: YOLOv8l at 640px or YOLOv8m at 1280px, 50 epochs
plan.hypothesis: A larger model or higher resolution with longer training will improve detection quality on dense grocery shelves.
plan.description: Based on step 9-10 results, pick the best approach and scale up. Try YOLOv8l at 640px batch=4 or YOLOv8m at 1280px batch=2, for 50 epochs with close_mosaic=10.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 0.05 over step 9/10 baseline

plan.title: DINOv2 embedding gallery + kNN classification on GT crops
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings from reference product images enable kNN classification that handles 356 categories better than YOLO's classification head.
plan.description: Build DINOv2-base embedding gallery from data/products/ reference images. Test kNN classification on val split using GT boxes to measure classification quality in isolation.
plan.success_criteria: kNN classification accuracy on GT crops exceeds 30% top-1 accuracy

plan.title: Two-stage pipeline: best detector + DINOv2 kNN classifier
plan.hypothesis: Combining the best single-class detector with DINOv2 classification yields higher val_score than multiclass YOLO alone.
plan.description: Use nc=1 detector boxes, crop from original image, classify via DINOv2 kNN. Compute full val_score. Tune conf threshold and NMS parameters.
plan.success_criteria: val_score exceeds best multiclass YOLO result

plan.title: NMS, confidence threshold, and max_det tuning
plan.hypothesis: With ~91 annotations per image, default NMS settings are suboptimal. Tuning should improve recall significantly.
plan.description: Sweep conf_threshold [0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.2], NMS IoU [0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.7], max_det [300, 500, 1000] on best detector.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 0.02 from threshold tuning

plan.title: Extended training: 100+ epochs with best configuration
plan.hypothesis: Longer training with close_mosaic=30 and optimized augmentation will significantly improve model quality.
plan.description: Retrain best detector for 100 epochs with close_mosaic=30. Use best resolution and model size from previous experiments.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 0.05 over shorter training

plan.title: Final pipeline optimization and submission package
plan.hypothesis: A properly packaged submission with optimized inference will reproduce development results within 300s budget.
plan.description: Profile complete pipeline. Optimize batch inference, FP16, minimize I/O. Write run.py, export models, package submission.zip (≤420MB, ≤3 weight files). Validate end-to-end.
plan.success_criteria: Submission package runs within 300s and reproduces val_score within 1%
